data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. Hello. Please guide your Azure AD administrator to verify that the 'emailaddress' and 'displayname' claims are correctly mapped in the enterprise application settings for CloudDesk. You can find detailed instructions in our Azure AD SSO configuration guide at https://docs.cloudesk.com/sso/azure-ad. [T-4386] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
